Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE final horizontal full-body sprite strip for 霜璃, EXACTLY EIGHT separate complete figures, solid uniform #00FF00 background, no labels.

REFERENCE ROLES:
1. PRIMARY HEAD-DIRECTION REFERENCE: the previously approved row10 direction board. The eight top figures and enlarged heads below show the CORRECT head angles in the CORRECT order. Match these eight physical head directions, especially the LEFT-facing profile at position 5 and UP-LEFT face at position 8. Do not copy its background, labels, closeup row, old small face or faint rendering.
2. AUTHORITATIVE NEW IDENTITY: reproduce this new canonical face and cleaner linework, body, white-lilac hair, lavender eyes, horns, white dress and silver rosette.
3. BODY GEOMETRY EDIT TARGET: accepted row9 at 2172x724. Preserve its eight frontal bodies, same raw figure height about 470 px, original planted feet at y611–613, waist-clasped hands, exact dress/slit/fold family, compact wings, attached tail, body positions and baseline. Its HEAD ANGLES are the WRONG HALF of the sweep for this task: do not copy those head angles. Use Image 1 for head orientation.
4. Supporting original identity references only.
5. Approved cardinal anchors (top, fourth is LEFT) and standard body contact sheet; preserve those new proportions and compact wings.

Output one coherent row of EIGHT full-body figures, with the same body scale, large readable face construction, linework, lighting and planted posture. All torsos remain FRONTAL. ONLY heads/necks/eyes and their attached hair, ears, horns and rosette turn. Do not mirror or turn any torso, dress, wings or tail.

EXACT LEFT-TO-RIGHT DIRECTIONS, copy Image 1's poses:
1 DOWN: front head with strong tucked chin, lowered physical eyes.
2 DOWN-LEFT: down pitch plus subtle LEFT yaw.
3 DOWN-LEFT: balanced LEFT yaw/down pitch.
4 DOWN-LEFT: mostly LEFT yaw, some down pitch.
5 LEFT: unmistakable nose and front facial surface project to the LEFT IMAGE EDGE, level chin. Follow reference1 head5 and reference5 fourth cardinal.
6 UP-LEFT: LEFT yaw with up pitch.
7 UP-LEFT: balanced LEFT yaw/up pitch.
8 UP-LEFT: MOSTLY UP but slight unmistakable LEFT yaw, following reference1 head8. Lift chin and physical eye surfaces; nose must remain LEFT of head center. Do not draw an up-RIGHT face here.

Every face from position2 through position8 aims toward the LEFT EDGE OF THE OUTPUT. Position8 retains a visible near-side silver rosette, as in reference1 head8. The head turns via neck, chin, whole face and physical lavender eyes with original eyelids/irises/highlights, not pupil-only sliding. Keep faces readable, no back-of-head view.
The silver temple rosette belongs to anatomical LEFT, viewer RIGHT in front view; on LEFT head yaw it remains on the VISIBLE NEAR TEMPLE, on the RIGHT side of that head. Never switch its attachment.
Preserve boundary continuity with Image3: new figure1 follows its last down-right figure through DOWN; new figure8 leads smoothly into its first UP figure.
Keep exactly eight ordered connected complete pose groups with pure-green separation and safe outer padding. No copied labels, numbers, closeups, diagrams or guide marks. No text, extra heads, effects, props, shadows, detached fragments, green inside figures, whole-character rotation or body rescaling.
